description: Registers a new wiki as an MCP resource by fetching its sitename and API configuration from any URL on the wiki (e.g. a page URL). The wiki becomes available at mcp://wikis/<servername> and can be targeted by passing its key as the `wiki` argument to any wiki tool. Fails if the URL is not a MediaWiki wiki or if a wiki with the same key is already registered.

wikiUrl.description: Any URL from the target wiki (e.g. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page)

name: add-wiki
